text:
emily: Quick heads-up — planning to open the release branch for v1.18 tomorrow 10:00 PT. Short checklist below, pls ack if you own any backports.

raj: ack — I'll own infra/backport for the scheduler fixes (PRs #4123, #4131).

lucas: I have a couple small client fixes (#4188) that need cherry-picking. ETA EOD today.

mia: FYI the changelog is missing the storage regression note — can someone drop the blurb? I can paste a draft.

emily: That'd be great, @mia. Drop it here and I'll move it into the changelog doc. Also tagging @zoe for canary rollout owners.

zoe: I can do canary. Quick question: do we want a single canary lane or staggered (canary1 -> canary2)? My vote: staggered.

raj: staggered makes sense given traffic shape. Will set autoscaling limit to 2 during canary window.

emily: Backport rules reminder: only bugfixes and security fixes. No behavior changes unless explicitly approved by PM. If in doubt, open a short thread with @emily + @raj.

lucas: For cherry-picks, how strict are we on changelog entries? I have a tiny fix but no user-facing impact.

emily: If no user-facing change, skip changelog. Still include the PR link in release notes under "internal fixes".

mia: Draft changelog snippet: "storage: fix rare txn abort during compaction (regression from 1.17.2). Backported by @mia." — ok to include?

emily: yep, that's good. I'll paste into release-notes.md after branch is created.

emily: Command I'll run at 10:00 PT: 
```
# from main at tip of trunk
git fetch origin
git checkout -b release/v1.18.0
git push origin release/v1.18.0
```

ops-bot: scheduled job: release-branch-create queued by emily for 3054219900

zoe: one more ask — can we freeze merges into main for anything risky 30m before branch creation? helps avoid last-second drift.

emily: yes — please hold risky merges after 9:30 PT. I'll send a short channel ping at 9:25.

raj: posting the backport checklist in the docs channel now. Also adding a short script to validate cherry-pick cleanly.

lucas: done with my PRs, will post backport PRs to the branch once it's live.

mia: acked — I'll paste the changelog now.

emily: Thanks everyone. If anything blocks, post here and I'll hold the cut. Otherwise branch will go live at 10:00 PT and I'll follow up with the canary plan and rollout window. :rocket:
